0022600099.text: The Bulls (0-1, 5th in the Central and 15th in the East) visit the Bucks (0-1, 4th in the Central and 13th in the East) in Chicago's second game of the season, with both teams a game back in their divisions and each on a one-game losing streak. Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury, and Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins are day-to-day with illness and are game-time decisions, while Milwaukee has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bulls lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, though Chicago won the most recent meeting 120-97 in Chicago on March 1, 2026.
